title: RFC 0010 Gate 2 capacity assumption sensitivity on fixed matched loads
purpose: One-factor-at-a-time sensitivity on the same Gate 1 node loads; not a probability distribution, posterior interval or fitted rupture model.

method.thermal_assumption: Stored Moho lag is compared with steady profile at the reference rheology; other OAT changes use the steady profile.
limitations: OAT isolates first-order sensitivity and does not estimate interactions among assumptions.
The stored Moho-lag interpolation is a diagnostic profile assumption, not a transient thermal solution.
Hydrostatic pore pressure assumes connected freshwater at 1000 kg/m3; fixed lithostatic fractions are comparison scenarios, not equivalent hydrostatic profiles.
Young-ridge classification remains the active-divergence proxy; the simulation has no oceanic crust-age field.
Threshold exceedance is a screening comparison and not a rupture probability or a calibrated yield label.

one_factor_scenario_envelope.interpretation: Minimum/maximum capacity across the finite OAT variants; not a joint uncertainty envelope.

provenance.capture_execution: Pinned Gate 1 source with the current diagnostic force-field helpers and thin-shell solver overlaid; baseline production torque routines retained.
